claims.assertion: Athena says Earth’s magnetic field fluctuates naturally through cycles and interactions with nearby planets and suns.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She says fluctuations are frequent, disputes a 12,000-year cycle, and says she does not know its basis.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says pole shifts require catastrophic events or strong external influence; she links the last to Tiamat’s waters reaching Earth.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She says magnetic fluctuations pose no danger, though they may slightly increase cosmic radiation and solar-wind particles.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
